_meta.title: Dong Gong (董公選擇要覽) per-ganzhi day-rating draft — RESEARCH DATA, NOT SHIPPED
_meta.structure: {solar month branch (寅..丑)} -> {day ganzhi} -> {rating, ratingEn, officer, sourceRefs}
_meta.derivation: Ratings are NOT printed labels in the classical text. They were derived deterministically from the classical commentary of three cross-checked online transcriptions by keyword extraction (vocabulary: 上吉/大吉/吉/次吉/平/凶/大凶 + mixed where the commentary praises some activities and forbids others). A cell is present ONLY where every source's independently derived rating agreed exactly; disagreeing cells are absent, never guessed.
_meta.coverage: 673 of 720 ganzhi-month cells (93.5%); 47 cells absent due to inter-source disagreement in the derived rating
_meta.independence_caveat: All three are online transcriptions that appear to descend from the same modern printed recension (wenxuecity and diancang are near-verbatim twins; tianyugong is an edited modernisation). Agreement here proves transcription fidelity, not recension-level independence. Verify against a printed edition before any user-facing use.
_meta.verification_plan: Spot-check 36 cells (3 per month, stratified across ratings) against a printed edition: Joey Yap, 'Dong Gong Date Selection' (JY Books, ISBN 983333251X) and/or a Taiwanese 通書 reprint of 董公選擇要覽. Any mismatch demotes the cell to absent.
